description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map4: Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01), the Otherworld streets of Central Silent Hill (map4_s02), the mall and its boss (map4_s03), the Lisa cutscene in the hospital (map4_s04) and the Floatstinger fight (map4_s05): doors, cutscenes and pickups.

M4S01_CabinetPushed.description: Set when Harry pushes the cabinet in Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01 MapEvent_PushCabinet); the cabinet then stays in its pushed place and the Cybil scene (event 9) starts.

M4S01_AntiqueShopCybilCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene with Cybil in Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01 Cutscene_AntiqueShopCybil, AQSH1.DMS). It starts the warp of event 10 and changes the shop's music.

M4S01_HoleRoomEntered.description: Set when Harry first goes through the map4_s01 door at point 17 into the room with the hole (room load to point 4). It starts the scene where he climbs down (event 13).

M4S01_HoleDescentCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry climbs down the hole in Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01 Cutscene_HoleRoomDescent, AQRM.DMS).

M4S01_CybilFindsHarryCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry blacks out in the hole room and Cybil finds him (map4_s01 Cutscene_CybilFindsHarry). It stops the fire effect of map4_s01 and starts the door event to map4_s04 (event 18, the 'Where am I?' dream).

M4S01_InspectedChalice.description: Set when Harry inspects the chalice in Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01, event 14: "Some kind of powder is left in the chalice."). Together with M2S04_SeenPoliceChalkboard it unlocks the botany book in Nowhere (M7S00_BotanyBookReadable).

M4S01_ReturnedFromHospitalDream.description: Completion flag of the map4_s04 door that brings Harry back to Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01 point 11) after the 'Where am I?' scene with Lisa. It starts the awakening scene (map4_s01 event 19).

M4S01_AwakeningCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry comes to in the antique shop after the dream ('Was that another dream? Did I pass out again?', map4_s01 Cutscene_SqsuScene, SQSU.DMS).

M4S01_PickupAxe.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the axe on map4_s01 (Green Lion Antiques (normal + Otherworld)) at map point 8 (x 174.8, z 21.4 m), event 16; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M4S01_CybilWalksToHarry.description: Set during the Cybil scene in Green Lion Antiques (map4_s01 Cutscene_AntiqueShopCybil step 12) when Cybil starts walking to Harry after calling his name. Only the music mix reads it (it lets the music fade in during the scene).

M4S01_HoleDescentStarted.description: Set during the hole scene of map4_s01 (Cutscene_HoleRoomDescent) when the hole's hum and glow begin. The shop's music switches to the hole layers once it is set.

M4S01_CutsceneWallShown.description: Set during the Cybil scene in Green Lion Antiques (step 40) and cleared at its end. While set, the wall object WALLX_HI is drawn in the shop.

M4S02_StreetMusicStarted.description: Music latch of the Otherworld central town streets (map4_s02/s03/s05 mix): while clear the street track plays only layer 1; it is set the first time Harry is south of z = 40 m, after which the per-room layers play.

M4S01_AfterCybilCutsceneWarpDone.description: Completion flag of the map4_s01 warp to point 18 that follows the Cybil scene in the antique shop; it only keeps the warp from repeating.

M4S02_MallFirstEntered.description: Completion flag of the first of the two map4_s02 doors at point 30 into the shopping mall (map4_s03 point 31): set the first time Harry goes in; later entries use the second door event.

M4S03_FenceSteppedOn.description: Set when Harry steps onto the fence at map4_s03 point 10 (130.8, -94.0). The fence then tips over and falls; the mall music of room 19 changes.

M4S03_FenceFallen.description: Set one second after the fence has started falling with Harry (map4_s03). It starts the warp to point 1 (event 13), which leads to the Twinfeeler attack.

M4S03_FenceFallAltLanding.description: Set together with M4S03_FenceFallen when the fence lands if a player property (Player_PropertyField10DGet, sh.map.harry_fall_direction) is non-zero. The Twinfeeler attack scene then starts Harry with the other landing animation (scene_twinfeeler_3 instead of _2).

M4S03_TwinfeelerArenaEntered.description: Completion flag of the warp to map4_s03 point 1 after the fence falls. It starts the Twinfeeler attack scene (event 14) and, while the fight is on, gives the boss its own update and textures.

M4S03_TwinfeelerAttackCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where the Twinfeeler bursts through the floor (map4_s03 Cutscene_TwinfeelerAttack); the boss fight starts. Before it the TV pictures are loaded and the small worms run in the grating.

M4S03_TwinfeelerFightAssetsLoaded.description: Per-visit latch of map4_s03: set by the spawn pass when the fight is on (M4S03_TwinfeelerArenaEntered) and the boss's update and textures have been loaded; cleared on map load while the fight is still unfinished, so they load again.

M4S03_TwinfeelerDefeated.description: Set by the Twinfeeler when it is beaten. It starts the scene where it dives into the wall (map4_s03 event 16).

M4S03_TwinfeelerDiveCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where the beaten Twinfeeler dives into the wall (map4_s03 Cutscene_TwinfeelerDive). It ends the fight music and lifts the collision that blocked the area.

M4S03_PickupHuntingRifle.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the hunting rifle on map4_s03 (Mall and boss fight) at map point 11 (x 117.0, z 145.8 m), event 8; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M4S03_TwinfeelerBurstOut.description: Set during the Twinfeeler attack scene when the boss bursts out (step 3) and at its end; the mall music switches to the boss layers once it is set.

M4S03_TvWallCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the TV wall scene in the mall (map4_s03 Cutscene_TvWallAwakens, triggered at point 24). It starts FMV 11 (event 4).

M4S03_TvWallFmvSeen.description: Completion flag of FMV 11 at the mall's TV wall; it starts the TV message scene (event 5, Cutscene_TwinfeelerTvMessage).

M4S03_TvMessageCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the line at the TV screens (map4_s03 Cutscene_TwinfeelerTvMessage). Afterwards the screens show their final picture and examining them says 'A picture is projected on the screen.' (events 26/27).

M4S03_TvScreensOn.description: Set during the TV wall scene when the screens come on; from then on the two TV sounds play while Harry is near the wall, and the music of room 18 changes.

M4S03_LeftTvWallRoom.description: Music latch of the mall: set when Harry is in room 19 (the room with the fence) on the mall track; afterwards room 18 (the TV wall) plays only its base layer.

M4S03_TwinfeelerFightResumePending.description: Set when map4_s03 loads with the Twinfeeler fight started but not won (M4S03_TwinfeelerAttackCutsceneDone set, M4S03_TwinfeelerDiveCutsceneDone clear); it runs Event_TwinfeelerResumeAttack (event 15), which restarts the boss without the intro and clears it.

M4S04_ArrivedInHospitalDream.description: Completion flag of the map4_s01 door that takes Harry, after Cybil finds him in the hole room, to map4_s04 (point 14). It starts the 'Where am I?' scene with Lisa (event 0) and switches a world object of map4_s04 on until M4S04_WhereAmICutsceneDone.

M4S04_WhereAmICutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry comes to next to Lisa ('Where am I?', map4_s04 MapEvent_CutsceneWhereAmI, HSPTL4.DMS). It starts the door back to Green Lion Antiques (event 1) and changes the music.

M4S04_LisaRoomEntered.description: Set when Harry goes through the map4_s04 door at point 1 into Lisa's room (room load to point 6). It starts the talk with Lisa (event 2) and changes the music.

M4S04_LisaTalkCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the talk with Lisa in the hospital (map4_s04 Cutscene_HospitalLisaTalk, HSPTL5.DMS). It opens the door to map4_s05 (event 11), starts the warp of event 3 and enables the worn lock in Old Town (map2_s00 event 134, InspectWornLock).

M4S04_AfterLisaTalkWarpDone.description: Completion flag of the map4_s04 warp to point 1 that follows the talk with Lisa; it only keeps the warp from repeating.

M4S05_StairwellEntered.description: Completion flag of the map4_s05 room load through the passage armed by TownStairwellEntryTriggered (to point 13). It starts the 'Cybil at the stairs' scene (event 0).

M4S05_CybilStairsSceneWarpDone.description: Set during the 'Cybil at the stairs' scene of map4_s05 (step 10, or on skip) when Cybil is placed on the stairs. It swaps the KIDN04_H object for KIDN05_H, switches the area's collision and makes the street music follow the Floatstinger fight.

M4S05_CybilStairsCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the 'Cybil at the stairs' scene of map4_s05. The Floatstinger fight starts: its spawn (with M4S05_FloatstingerKilled clear) and its fight behaviour depend on it.

M4S05_FloatstingerKilled.description: Set by the Floatstinger when it dies. It stops its spawn, changes the music and starts the 'Cybil aims at Harry' scene (event 1).

M4S05_FloatstingerLandingTriggered.description: Set during the scene after the Floatstinger's death (map4_s05 MapEvent_CybilAimScene step 4); the dying Floatstinger, hovering down, then plays its landing animation.

M4S05_CybilAimCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the 'Cybil aims at Harry' scene after the Floatstinger fight (map4_s05). It opens the door to map2_s02 (event 2), where the darkness event (M2S02_BackFromOtherworld) follows, and changes the town music.

M4S05_ChannelingStoneUsed.description: Channeling Stone used at the map4_s05 (Otherworld central Silent Hill) spot, point 17 (UFO2.DMS, UFO over the roof). One of the four spots required for the UFO ending.

M4S03_FirstAidKit.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the first aid kit on map4_s03 (Mall and boss fight) at map point 27 (x 217.8, z -17.3 m), event 0; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M4S03_RifleShells0.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the rifle shells on map4_s03 (Mall and boss fight) at map point 28 (x 220.0, z -21.0 m), event 1; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M4S03_RifleShells1.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the rifle shells on map4_s03 (Mall and boss fight) at map point 29 (x 219.8, z -20.9 m), event 2; once set the pickup is gone for good.
